title: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Simple Form Builder Web App 1.0. (CVE-2026-132610)
description: SourceCodester Simple Form Builder Web App 1.0 contains a security flaw in the save_form function within /classes/Forms.php. This flaw allows remote attackers to perform code injection by manipulating the form_code or form_data arguments. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.3, indicating high severity, and public exploit code has been released.
